verdict.rationale: Cline ships an official CLI (npm install -g cline) with documented interactive and headless modes, scripting/automation support, cron scheduling via hub, and terminal-based execution reacting live to output — clearly evidenced across multiple first-party docs pages and a dedicated probe confirming the CLI overview page. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the CLI (community quotes focus on IDE/editor usage, not CLI), and no third-party review of CLI reliability.
